name: S3 Cache action
description: Cache files on S3 with branch-specific paths for granular permissions

path.description: A list of files, directories, and wildcard patterns to cache and restore

key.description: An explicit key for restoring and saving the cache

restore-keys.description: An ordered list of prefix-matched keys to use for restoring stale cache if no cache hit occurred for key

upload-chunk-size.description: The chunk size used to split up large files during upload, in bytes

enableCrossOsArchive.description: When enabled, allows to save or restore caches that can be restored or saved respectively on other platforms

fail-on-cache-miss.description: Fail the workflow if cache entry is not found

lookup-only.description: Check if a cache entry exists for the given input(s) (key, restore-keys) without downloading the cache

environment.description: Environment to use ('dev' or 'prod', 's3' backend only).

fallback-branch.description: Explicit fallback branch for restore keys (pattern 'branch-*', 's3' backend only). Always honoured when set, regardless of 'fallback-to-default-branch'. If not

fallback-to-default-branch.description: When enabled, automatically adds a fallback restore key pointing to the default branch cache. Only applies to the S3 backend.

backend.description: Force cache backend ('github' or 's3'). If not set, falls back to the CACHE_BACKEND environment variable if defined, then automatically determined based on repo

import-github-cache.description: Import GitHub cache to S3 when no S3 cache exists (migration mode). Enabled by default when using S3 backend. Set to 'false' to disable, or control via the CACH
